requirement: Add a static route on router edge-dc so that the network 172.16.8.0/24 is reachable via 192.168.44.1.

proposal.rationale: The requirement specifies adding a static route to reach the network 172.16.8.0/24 via 192.168.44.1 on router edge-dc. However, edge-dc is not listed in the provided inventory of devices.
